notes:
词组释义与用法场景职责纠偏；订正标题与「为什么这么改」独立折叠
1. 优化：短词组 Meaning 只保留短释义；情景 / 俚语 / 母语选用意图放到 Usage Contexts（含开场白 usageIntro）
2. 优化：长句 / 段落 Meaning 仍要求完整逐句翻译，不受短词组规则误伤
3. 修复：超长订正标题独立折叠；黄色「为什么这么改？」不再被一起裁切

notes_en:
Phrase Meaning vs Usage Contexts ownership; independent fold for corrected title vs “why changed”
1. **Improved**: Short phrases keep Meaning as a gloss; situational / slang / native-intent copy moves to Usage Contexts (with usageIntro blurb)
2. **Improved**: Long sentences / paragraphs still require full line-by-line translation in Meaning
3. **Fix**: Long corrected titles fold on their own; amber “why changed” is no longer clipped with them
